name: Youth4work MCP
summary: MCP for India's Youth4work careers platform: public read-only talent/jobs/tests search, plus OAuth tools for a signed-in seeker or employer account.
description: Two Streamable HTTP endpoints. Public (no auth, 60 req/min/IP) at https://mcp.youth4work.com/public/mcp: search_talent, get_profile, search_jobs, get_job, search_mock_tests, get_mock_test, search_colleges, get_college (public data only; no contacts). Signed-in server at https://mcp.youth4work.com/mcp (OAuth 2.1 with DCR and PKCE): job-seeker profile/skills/applications and employer job posts, applicants, assessments and candidate search. Same tools over OpenAPI at mcp.youth4work.com/openapi.json. Free skill tests and public profiles on the site; messaging and filtered talent search need sign-in.

agent_access.notes: OAuth on /mcp; keyless public read-only MCP at /public/mcp.
